name: @thetis/host-trials
description: Runs one request twice, with and without one harness change, on the real Thetis with every write going to RAM: the person's space, their read-write folders and the code are overlaid onto a tmpfs, the docker socket and every host socket are masked, and their workspace gets no network. A host package: loaded by the daemon per call as host.trials.<export>, never installed into a fence.

thetis.label: trials
thetis.summary: Tries a proposed change on a copy of your space before you adopt it.
